chunks: To God leads the right path, though some deviate. If He willed He could guide you all to the right way.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God could guide everyone but some still deviate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between God's absolute power to guide all (if He willed) and His wisdom in granting humans free will, allowing for both the straight path and deviation. It underscores that guidance is ultimately a divine act, yet human choice remains the mechanism through which individuals either follow or stray from the 'straight path' (Qasd al-Sabil). This reflects the Shia understanding of divine justice, where God does not compel belief but provides clear signs for those who choose to follow.
